title: NAFEMS LE10 thick plate
sentence: LE1's elliptic membrane extruded into a 3D plate under uniform pressure — a 3D solid benchmark.

expected.quantity: σ_yy at D on the upper surface

theory: LE10 is LE1's section as a $0.6\,\mathrm{m}$ thick plate under $1\,\mathrm{MPa}$. The published target $\sigma_{yy} = -5.38\,\mathrm{MPa}$ is on the upper surface at D, so it is a bending stress and needs enough elements through the thickness. This bundled model clamps the full outer face rather than LE10's mid-plane support line; issue #183 tracks the matching support variant, so the published value is context here rather than a claimed verification.
